app.name: ftpii-ng
app.long_description:
ftpii-ng is a rewrite of ftpii: pipelined SD/USB transfers, live speed display, resume support, MLSD/EPSV, and no more hung clients.
HOME / START: exit. B: remount SD/USB. Password: rename apps/ftpii-ng to apps/ftpii_YourPassword, or SITE PASSWD / SITE NOPASSWD.
